seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor: Hey HN, we’re Wei-Wei and Jeff. We’re building Momentic, QA agents that autonomously plan, explore, and bug-bash controls and user flows in your web, iOS, Android, and (soon) desktop apps to catch bugs. Here’s a demo:  https://youtu.be/BFsM-Se1Fh8  We’re both software engineers that spent our careers on dev tooling and infra across companies like Robinhood, Retool, WeWork, and Qualtrics. Testing was always a pain in the ass (esp Playwright and Selenium), so we built agents to do it for us. Modern day software has a ton of bugs and the change failure rate is only growing faster as coding agent adoption scales. LLMs are really good at generating code, but reinforce their own assumptions, write a ton of useless tests, and are bad at visual understanding. On DeepSWE v1.1, Sonnet 5.5 hit 66.2% pass rate when banned from writing tests, versus 65.3% when allowed.
